name: Regional control API
description: Authenticated JSON commands/queries to Core. Method POST; type + version selects operation. HTTP 200 for completed, 202 for durable accepted, 400 invalid-payload, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not-found, 409 conflict/stale revision, 429 quota and 503 unavailable. Body is the declared reply or CommandResult. TLS identity and request correlation scope replies. Bootstrap endpoints are configured, not inferred from a session ID.

name: Operator control API
description: Separate service/operator audience with mTLS or strong operator credentials. Drain, policy, revocation and season-finalization actions are audited. Never expose ordinary-player authorization here. Same request/reply/error envelope as ControlAPI.

name: Client control connection
description: Socket-hosted WSS JSON control connection. First Connect frame within five seconds. One envelope per message, tenant/principal quotas, replaceable projections and explicit reconnect snapshots. Control mutations relay to Core; game ticks never transit a durable broker.

name: Regional lifecycle stream
description: Broker-neutral at-least-once durable lifecycle stream. Reference adapter: regional NATS JetStream or Kafka with persisted acknowledgements and per-aggregate routing. Ordered per producer-owned aggregate only. Core subscribers use competing workers; Socket fanout must reach each interested gateway, not just one random consumer. Topic ACLs bind allowed producer/type. Seven-day retention, eight-day inbox dedup; see domain redrive contract.

name: Targeted engine commands
description: Target one engine incarnation. Never load-balance session commands to arbitrary engines. Expired/stale allocation epoch is rejected. Durable at-least-once commands plus Core reconciler provide recovery from missed acknowledgements. Drain of a multi-tenant engine is sent by its authenticated operator authority; receiver reconciles every hosted tenant before it can report EngineDrained.

name: Directed media signaling
description: Authenticated direct or Socket-relayed signaling to the current owner. SDP/ICE/admission secrets are excluded from durable topics. Bind all exchanges to negotiationId, player, epoch and connection generation. Replies return only over original authorized exchange.

name: Logical game data
description: Logical channel carried by exactly one negotiated data adapter. WebSocket reliable-ordered, WebRTC data channel reliability explicit, secure UDP unreliable-sequenced. JSON debug/v1 envelope must fit transport budget including base64; large full state uses reliable transport. These are ephemeral messages, never a Kafka/NATS tick stream.

name: Logical audio/video tracks
description: Default audio/video data plane: negotiated RTP/RTCP protected with DTLS-SRTP. ChannelOpened binds logical channel to negotiated track. These packets are protocol frames, not JSON lifecycle events, so this channel intentionally has no event schemas. Alternative codec framing over WS/data-channel/secure UDP is offered only with a game-owned framing and jitter manifest.

name: Authenticated directed replies
description: Virtual response route for CommandResult. Same authenticated request or WSS connection; the server never accepts a client-supplied broker reply destination. Result requestId identifies the command messageId; correlationId is observability only.

name: Statistics and ranking updates
description: Separate bounded workload from allocation/control. Engine publishes cumulative provisional samples at up to 1 Hz per player shard; Core validates current epoch and publishes settled result/stat/leaderboard revisions. Core projection workers ingest ClickHouse and Redis through inbox/outbox. No tick-by-tick game/media payloads. Delivery is at-least-once and materializations must deduplicate.

name: Non-RTP codec frames
description: Optional negotiated audio/video codec frames over the common data-adapter interface. PublishMediaFrame/MediaFrame carry timestamps, sequence and codec payload; enforce full encoded-message size budgets and encryption overhead. Opus packets may fit datagrams; oversized video requires reliable transport or standard RTP packetization, never implicit v1 UDP fragmentation. Unsupported codec packetization is refused. This is ephemeral live traffic, not a broker topic.

name: Session recording metadata stream
description: Durable event-record indexing and media manifest notifications. Source event capture precedes publication; this broker is a delivery/indexing mechanism, not the only archive. Deduplicate stable event and segment identities. Mandatory gameplay events never drop under broker pressure: persist outbox/backpressure. Raw audio/video remains in private object storage, never embedded in this stream.
